name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for aircraft design, leading him to pursue a degree in aerospace engineering. He quickly realized his passion lay in the practical application of composite materials, and transitioned to motorsport, drawn to the fast-paced, high-stakes environment. His meticulous approach to composite repair and fabrication has earned him a reputation for reliability and precision.

Over the years, Alistair has honed his skills at various levels of racing, from Formula Ford to endurance events. He is known for his demanding nature, pushing himself and his team to achieve the highest standards. He's not afraid to challenge conventional thinking and is always seeking innovative solutions to improve performance. His ability to blend traditional techniques with modern advancements makes him a valuable asset to any team.

While Alistair demands high performance, he is also committed to mentoring young engineers. He believes in fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement, ensuring that his team remains at the forefront of composite technology. His dedication to excellence and his ability to inspire others make him a unique and respected figure in the paddock.

physical.description: Alistair is a stocky man with a weathered face, reflecting years spent working in demanding environments.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Insists on using a specific type of carbon fiber for all repairs.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his wrench three times before tightening a bolt.
